description: Use this when a design or a saved asset needs a ready-made piece rather than art you draw: SF Symbols, emoji, 3D shapes, glows and blobs, seasonal art, store badges, ratings, payment and social marks and more (a few thousand pieces). Returns the best matches with their path, which a library layer takes (create_design and edit_asset), and one image showing them in order, left to right then down. With no match it lists the categories. Read-only.

category.description: Keep one category, such as sf-symbols, emoji, 3d, decorative, seasonal, badges or shapes.

limit.description: How many to return, best first.

query.description: Words for what the piece shows, such as "heart", "sparkle", "3d cube", "apple pay", "christmas".

name: search_library
title: Search the appdesigns library
